sloka: कस्मात् त्वं मां विहायेह कृपणां गन्तुमिच्छसि ।दीनां विलपितैर्मन्दां किंवा मां नाभिभाषसे ।। ६.११४.६१ ।।
transliteration: kasmāt tvaṁ māṁ vihāyeha kṛpaṇāṁ gantumicchasi ।dīnāṁ vilapitairmandāṁ kiṁvā māṁ nābhibhāṣase ।। 6.114.61 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Today, take me on your journey which is very difficult. Stricken with sorrow I cannot live without you."
